technique_name: Describe the effects of climate change on the lifestyle of an East African farmer.
description: Climate change has had many direct and indirect impacts on the lifestyle of an East African farmer. Changes in precipitation and temperature patterns, increases in drought duration, and soil moisture deficits can lead to decreased crop yields, degraded pastures, and decreased livestock productivity. Poor farmers may also suffer from increasing food prices, as higher temperatures reduce crop yields, thereby driving up prices.
